def build_text_table(dataset_name, data_dir, user_train, itemnum):
    # An explicit path may contain {dataset}. Only public title/description
    # fields are consumed; metadata keys must use the supplied numeric item IDs.
    configured = os.environ.get("HSTU_METADATA_JSON")
    paths = ([configured.format(dataset=dataset_name)] if configured else [
        os.path.join(data_dir, f"{dataset_name}_metadata.json"),
        os.path.join(data_dir, f"{dataset_name}_meta.json"),
    ])
    path = next((p for p in paths if os.path.isfile(p)), None)
    if configured and path is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(paths[0])
    records = {}
    if path is not None:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            records = json.load(stream)
        if not isinstance(records, dict):
            raise ValueError("Metadata JSON must map numeric item IDs to records")
        if dataset_name in records:
            records = records[dataset_name]
        if not isinstance(records, dict):
            raise ValueError("Category metadata must be an item-ID mapping")

    def tokenize(value):
        if isinstance(value, list):
            value = " ".join(v for v in value if isinstance(v, str))
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            return []
        value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", value).casefold()
        return re.findall(r"\w+|[^\w\s]", value, flags=re.UNICODE)

    fields = {}
    for key, record in records.items():
        try:
            item = int(key)
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            continue
        if not 1 <= item <= itemnum or not isinstance(record, dict):
            continue
        fields[item] = (
            tokenize(record.get("title", ""))[:32],
            tokenize(record.get("description", ""))[:96],
        )
    counts = Counter()
    training_items = sorted({i for history in user_train.values() for i in history})
    for item in training_items:
        for field in fields.get(item, ([], [])):
            counts.update(field)
    words = sorted((w for w, count in counts.items() if count >= 2),
                   key=lambda w: (-counts[w], w))[:29998]
    vocab = {"<PAD>": 0, "<UNK>": 1}
    vocab.update({word: index + 2 for index, word in enumerate(words)})
    table = torch.zeros((itemnum + 1, 128), dtype=torch.long)
    for item, (title, description) in fields.items():
        for offset, tokens in ((0, title), (32, description)):
            if tokens:
                table[item, offset:offset + len(tokens)] = torch.tensor(
                    [vocab.get(token, 1) for token in tokens], dtype=torch.long)
    available = int(table.ne(0).any(dim=1).sum())
    print(f"  [{dataset_name}] text source={path!r}, available={available}/{itemnum}, "
          f"vocabulary={len(vocab)}, mode={TEXT_MODE}", flush=True)
    return table, vocab, {
        "normalization": "NFKC+casefold",
        "token_pattern": r"\w+|[^\w\s]",
        "field_lengths": [32, 96],
        "truncation": "first tokens of each field, independently",
        "min_frequency": 2,
        "vocabulary_limit": 30000,
        "vocabulary_source": "training interaction item metadata",
        "source_path": path,
    }
